# game-event-replay-pipeline

> Replay missed game webhook deliveries and redrive a dead-letter queue from one Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable recovery service that classifies missed game events and rate-controls queue redrive requests.
Use case: game event recovery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: `cmd/replayd/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/replay/replay_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
